errors: "revised full-year 2026 non-GAAP EPS expectations to $35.50 to $36.50 from the prior guidance of $32.72 to $33.72" - the prior (Q1) guide was $35.50-$37.00; $32.72-$33.72 appears nowhere in either transcript.
"from $32.72 to $33.72 (which was lowered previously from $35.50 to $37.00)" - invented sequence; Q1 raised EPS guidance to $35.50-$37 and Q2 moved it directly to $35.50-$36.50.

Jason Gerberry Q&A: Van Naarden 'stated that investments in psychiatry and infectious disease remain opportunistic ... rather than targets to build out fully scaled franchises' marked 'answered directly' - he said he did not 'want to forward look too much' on whether Lilly builds more there; he did not rule out scaled franchises.
summaries.comment: Well structured and mostly accurate, but the fabricated prior EPS guidance range (repeated in two sections) is a serious error on the most important number-moved item, and the empty unanswered list ignores clear partial answers.

errors: "Dave Ricks ... confirmed retatrutide qualifies as a biologic under regulatory rules" - Ricks said 'we believe' it is a biologic, 'That's our position', with a mixed first court decision and active litigation.
Key metric "Foundayo Q2 U.S. Revenue: $67 million (reported in Q2 2026)" - the $67M figure was cited by analyst Dave Risinger in his question, not reported by management on the call.
New mentions list "Ebglyss", "Jaypirca", "INLURIYO", "KISUNLA" - all four were named in the prior quarter's call as key products.

Dropped topics list "Centessa Pharmaceuticals", "Kelonia Therapeutics", "Ajax Therapeutics", "ADorable-1 trial" - all were discussed in Q2 (Centessa acquisition complete, Ajax and Kelonia programs, ADorable program pediatric submission).
summaries.comment: Headline numbers and guidance moves are right, but it overstates retatrutide's biologic status as confirmed, presents an analyst's figure as reported revenue, and its what-changed lists are substantially wrong.

errors: "Eli Lilly reported fiscal Q2 2026 revenue of $85 billion to $87 billion" - that is the full-year 2026 revenue guidance, not Q2 revenue.
"Full-year 2026 non-GAAP earnings per share guidance is $35.50 to $36.50, updated from the prior range of $32.72 to $33.72" (also in What changed) - the Q1 guide was $35.50-$37.
"The Medicare Bridge program increased obesity access by 35% for seniors" - Ricks said 35% more people in the U.S. now have coverage for Lilly's obesity medicines, not a 35% increase for seniors.
Seamus Fernandez answer attributed to Ilya Yuffa includes 'outside the U.S. the business is mainly out of pocket', which was said by Patrik Jonsson.
New mentions list "Ebglyss", "Jaypirca", "Orforglipron", "INLURIYO", "KISUNLA" - all were discussed in the prior quarter's call.
Risk "Potential supply constraints ... from generic semaglutide manufacturers" - Jonsson described supply constraints at generic competitors, not a risk to Lilly's supply.
summaries.comment: The overview misstates full-year guidance as Q2 revenue and the EPS prior range is fabricated, undermining an otherwise reasonable skeleton.

errors: "Patrik Jonsson, President, Lilly International, said Lilly's international incretin share is about 55% in a market up 74%" - these figures came from Lucas Montarce's prepared remarks, not Jonsson.
Guidance bullet: "Ricks expects ... a global rollout in all major markets in 2027" - the 2027 global rollout statement was made by Lucas Montarce.
summaries.comment: The most thorough and analytically sharp version with fair partial-answer reads and a real tone-shift observation, but it runs well over 900 words and misattributes two prepared-remarks figures.
Clean, accurately attributed and tight, with correct guidance moves, fair unanswered list and a grounded tone-shift comparison; only lightly covers the pipeline.

errors: Key metrics label $6.8B, $14.9B, $6.3B, $3B and $85B all as "Q2 Revenue" - these are key-product growth, Mounjaro+Zepbound revenue, their growth, a guidance raise and the full-year guide low end.
Q&A answers attributed to "Mike Czapar" (Geoff Meacham, Mohit Bansal questions) - answers were given by Ken Custer and Jake Van Naarden; askers are left blank.
New mentions "Retinoid treatments" - not discussed on the call.
Dropped topics "Revenue growth", "Mounjaro expansion", "International market growth" - all were central to the Q2 call.
summaries.comment: Essentially a failed output: topic labels instead of findings, mislabeled numbers, raw transcript pasted as Q&A, and nonsensical what-changed lists.

errors: Risk: "Novo Nordisk's oral is scaling in the U.K., Germany and the UAE ... per Jonsson" - that was analyst Asad Haider's statement in his question; Jonsson did not say it.
summaries.comment: Dense and insightful, with fair partial reads, a well-chosen unanswered list and a substantive what-changed section, marred by one misattributed risk and a slightly overstated 'conceded a slower launch' tone claim.

errors: Asad Haider answer attributed to Ilya Yuffa includes 'combined incretin share held steady outside the U.S.', which was Patrik Jonsson's comment.
New mentions "INLURIYO" and "cleminorexton" - both were discussed in the prior quarter's call (Inluriyo launch, Centessa's lead candidate cleminorexton).
summaries.comment: Accurate on headline numbers but many takeaways and guidance bullets lack named attribution, the Q&A reads are uniformly 'direct' with an empty unanswered list, and insight is limited.
